description: Save important context, decisions, or learnings about a file or symbol for future reference. Use this when you discover important information about code behavior, architectural decisions, bug fixes, or gotchas that would be valuable for future work. Notes are stored persistently and will appear in future impact analysis results.

file_path.description: File path the note relates to

repo_root.description: Absolute path to the git repository root

symbol_name.description: Optional symbol name the note relates to

name: save_project_note
